import re,os,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w)]
    cols={}; rows={}
    for v in set(c[2] for c in cells): cols[v]=set(); rows[v]=set()
    for i,j,v in cells: cols[v].add(j); rows[v].add(i)
    marker=[v for v in cols if v!=bg and (len(cols[v])==1 or len(rows[v])==1)][0]
    other=[v for v in cols if v not in (bg,marker)][0]
    mcells=[(i,j) for i,j,v in cells if v==marker]
    scells=[(i,j) for i,j,v in cells if v==other]
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    if len(cols[marker])==1:  # vertical marker
        mj=mcells[0][1]
        smax=max(j for i,j in scells); smin=min(j for i,j in scells)
        if mj>smax: sh=(mj-1)-smax  # move right to touch
        else: sh=(mj+1)-smin
        for i,j in scells: out[i][j+sh]=other
        jl=min(i for i,j in scells) if False else None
        jline=(min(j for i,j in scells)+sh)-1 if mj>smax else (max(j for i,j in scells)+sh)+1
        for i in range(h): out[i][jline]=8
    else:
        mi=mcells[0][0]
        smax=max(i for i,j in scells); smin=min(i for i,j in scells)
        if mi>smax: sh=(mi-1)-smax
        else: sh=(mi+1)-smin
        for i,j in scells: out[i+sh][j]=other
        iline=(min(i for i,j in scells)+sh)-1 if mi>smax else (max(i for i,j in scells)+sh)+1
        for j in range(w): out[iline][j]=8
    return out

src='''def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w)]
    cols={v:set() for v in set(c[2] for c in cells)}
    rows={v:set() for v in cols}
    for i,j,v in cells: cols[v].add(j); rows[v].add(i)
    marker=[v for v in cols if v!=bg and (len(cols[v])==1 or len(rows[v])==1)][0]
    other=[v for v in cols if v not in (bg,marker)][0]
    mcells=[(i,j) for i,j,v in cells if v==marker]
    scells=[(i,j) for i,j,v in cells if v==other]
    out=[[v if v==marker else bg for v in r] for r in g]
    if len(cols[marker])==1:
        mj=mcells[0][1]
        smax=max(j for i,j in scells); smin=min(j for i,j in scells)
        if mj>smax:
            sh=(mj-1)-smax; jline=smin+sh-1
        else:
            sh=(mj+1)-smin; jline=smax+sh+1
        for i,j in scells: out[i][j+sh]=other
        for i in range(h): out[i][jline]=8
    else:
        mi=mcells[0][0]
        smax=max(i for i,j in scells); smin=min(i for i,j in scells)
        if mi>smax:
            sh=(mi-1)-smax; iline=smin+sh-1
        else:
            sh=(mi+1)-smin; iline=smax+sh+1
        for i,j in scells: out[i+sh][j]=other
        for j in range(w): out[iline][j]=8
    return out
'''
